brief.goal: Fix max_quantity in inventory.py to return None for an empty list and the largest quantity for nonempty lists, including all-negative quantities.
brief.context: Project: /tmp/anthill-qa-two-ends only. inventory.py currently initializes best = 0, returning 0 for empty and all-negative lists. The user confirmed scope, constraints, verification, and routing before this design handover.
assumptions: The one retry is available after either initial test failure or first independent review rejection, as explicitly confirmed by the user.
Malformed items and missing qty keys are outside this task.
brief.verification: From this folder, run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_inventory.py. Verify empty input -> None, all-negative input -> largest negative qty, and normal lists -> largest qty. Independently review implementation, assertions, command results, and changed-file scope.
doneCriteria: Nonempty lists of inventory dictionaries return the greatest qty, including all-negative and normal lists.
test_inventory.py uses unittest and covers empty, negative, and normal lists; the suite passes.
An independent reviewer approves the passing implementation before Approved is reached.
There is at most one retry fix and test run shared between a first test failure and a first review rejection; exhausted or rejected retries reach Needs attention.
The graph has exactly two End blocks named Approved and Needs attention.
constraints: Only inventory.py and a new test_inventory.py in this folder may be changed as task files.
Preserve the max_quantity(items) signature and inventory dictionaries using the qty key.
Use the Python standard library unittest; add no dependencies.
Every branching connection uses switch, with explicit conditions and a labeled otherwise fallback.
Use a separate Codex subagent for independent review, inheriting the current session model.
All remaining implementation and test case choices are delegated to Codex.
prohibitedActions: Do not change task files outside /tmp/anthill-qa-two-ends.
Do not edit unrelated files, install dependencies, create projects, commit, publish, or change repository instruction files.
Do not perform a second retry fix or approve after failed tests or a final review rejection.
brief.finalAction: Report the terminal outcome, files changed, unittest command and results, independent review decision, and any unresolved issues. Approved requires passing tests and independent approval; Needs attention records exhausted retry or final review rejection.

nodes.name: Fix inventory and add unittest coverage

config.task: Read inventory.py and fix the zero initialization bug without changing the public signature. Return None on empty input and the actual greatest qty for nonempty input, including all-negative quantities. Add test_inventory.py with unittest assertions for empty, negative, and normal lists. Change only these two files.
config.expectedOutput: Updated inventory.py and test_inventory.py covering the three required list categories.
successCriteria: All-negative and normal lists return their actual maximum qty.
Only the two permitted task files are changed.

config.task: Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_inventory.py from the project folder. Record developer.testResult as passed only for a successful exit and all required cases passing, otherwise failed with diagnostics. Route passed to independent review and any other result to the single retry.
config.expectedOutput: Test command, output, exit status, and developer.testResult passed or failed.

config.task: Use an independent Codex review subagent after first tests pass. Inspect inventory.py, test_inventory.py, the test output, and changed-file scope against all criteria. Do not edit files. Record independent-reviewer.decision as approved or changes_requested with specific findings. Approval reaches Approved; rejection consumes the one retry fix and test run.
config.expectedOutput: Independent review verdict approved or changes_requested, with findings tied to the success criteria.
successCriteria: Review is performed by a separate subagent.
Review implementation, coverage, test result, and scope.
A rejection provides concrete issues for the retry.

config.task: Perform the one permitted retry after initial test failure or first independent review rejection. Address the observed test diagnostics or reviewer findings in inventory.py and test_inventory.py only. Do not perform another repair round after this step.
config.expectedOutput: One repair attempt confined to the two permitted files, with its cause documented.
successCriteria: Address the triggering diagnostics or findings.

config.task: Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_inventory.py once after the retry fix. Record developer.testResult passed only for successful exit and all required cases passing; otherwise failed with diagnostics. Passed goes to independent final review; failure or any other result goes to Needs attention without further changes.
config.expectedOutput: Retry test command, output, exit status, and developer.testResult.
successCriteria: No further repair is attempted if tests fail.

config.task: Use an independent Codex review subagent after retry tests pass. Independently check current inventory.py, test_inventory.py, passing test evidence, permitted scope, and resolution of any prior findings. Do not edit files. Record independent-reviewer.decision approved or changes_requested. Approved reaches Approved; final rejection, including a second review rejection, reaches Needs attention. No additional fix or review cycle is allowed.
config.expectedOutput: Final independent verdict and any unresolved issues.
successCriteria: Review is independent of the implementer.
Every required behavior and coverage category is checked.
A final rejection ends at Needs attention.

agents.name: Developer
agents.role: Implement and test the inventory fix within the confirmed folder.
agents.description: Read inventory.py and replace its zero initialization behavior so max_quantity returns None for empty input and the greatest qty for nonempty lists. Add test_inventory.py with unittest coverage for empty, negative, and normal lists, then run the suite with bytecode writing disabled. Record test results accurately and use at most one retry repair for either a failed first test run or an independent review rejection. Hand implementation, test evidence, and changed-file scope to the reviewer; do not edit outside the two allowed task files or continue repairs after the retry.

agents.name: Independent reviewer
agents.role: A separate Codex subagent independently reviews passing inventory changes.
agents.description: Perform the first review after initial tests pass, or the final review after retry tests pass, using a separate Codex subagent rather than the implementer. Read inventory.py, test_inventory.py, test evidence, and change scope to verify empty input, negative quantities, normal lists, and explicit unittest assertions. Return approved or changes_requested with concrete findings and no file edits. A first rejection allows the single retry, while final rejection terminates at Needs attention; approval is justified only by all criteria holding.
